newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian RAMS plans A$200 mln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian RAMS plans A$200 mln bond issue.

text.p: Australian non-bank lender RAMS said it plans to launch a A$200 million issue in its Series 2 Bonds on March 17.

RAMS Director said it would also make a final A$200 million issue in the series before June due to strong investor demand, which will take the aggregate programme size in the Series 2 bonds to A$1.0 billion.
The bonds are expected to be allocated on March 12, according to Bankers Trust Australia, which is the lead manager and placement agency for the series.
J.P. Morgan Australia Securities is participating as a co-placement agent.

Strong demand was seen for RAMS' last issue in November with an effective margin above bank bills of 18.95 basis points - the first time a mortgage-backed bond had priced below an average margin of 20 basis points.

The new issue will be fully fungible with the existing A$600 million of Series 2 bonds, and the A Class (senior) tranches were expected to be rated AAA/Aaa by Standard & Poor's and Moody's, and the B (junior) tranche rated AA- by S&P.
